name: haxelib
releasenote:
* Redesign download/install progress display with colored bars, elapsed/eta and a spinner
 * Stream git's own progress instead of running it silently, with a stall watchdog and auto-retry
 * Recover automatically from a corrupted vcs install instead of crashing
 * Report the specific commit/version an update moves to, with `update --check` for a dry run
 * Tag console output with [INFO]/[WARN]/[ERROR]/[DEBUG]
